context: Historical August 2026 model-zoo archaeology cited the filename TOWER_GPT(9).py but source bytes were missing. A similarly named owner's library file has now been retrieved for static inspection. Filename resemblance is not proof of byte-identical source.

sources.name: TOWER_GPT(9)(4).py
sources.observed_architecture: Default pool of 20 independent tiny GPT agents with causal attention and scalar autodiff, mutation/absorption, score-based champion selection, trial configuration search, architecture variation and optional champion serialization.
negative_findings: MicroGPTAgent training/evaluation in _evaluate_agent samples the agent's own text then trains on it; this is not an independently frozen holdout.

cobble_generator clones and mutates champion, then calls child.__init__, reinitializing the changed-architecture model and discarding the inherited weights; genotype lineage is not parameter inheritance.
SimpleBayesianOptimizer.ask uses sampling around the current best or random sampling, without an observed Bayesian posterior/surrogate inference step in that method.
TachyonPredictor.predict is historical score averaging conditioned on similar learning rates and default 0.5 before 10 samples, not time travel or independent forecasting evidence.
champion_model.pkl uses pickle serialization; never load untrusted pickle or copy raw runtime.
Legacy main includes a potentially unbounded loop and terminal os.system clear; must not execute as part of ESSENCE archive intake.
Changing architecture and zipping parameter lists risks silent incompatible/partial transfer; explicit shape agreement and holdout required.
